sources.title: AriGraph: Learning Knowledge Graph World Models with Episodic Memory for LLM Agents
sources.summary: # AriGraph: Learning Knowledge Graph World Models with Episodic Memory for LLM Agents AriGraph functions as the external memory architecture for large language models (LLMs), featuring a knowledge graph that is built from the ground up. This memory, configured as a semantic knowledge graph with added episodic vertices and edges, greatly improves the performance of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in text-based games. sources.title: PRINCESS970000/mcp-memory-rag-engine
sources.summary: An enterprise-grade extension for Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents. Features a structured long-term memory system (short-term scratchpad, episodic routing, and semantic consolidation with conflict resolution), evaluated context management strategies, and a multi-architecture RAG pipeline (Naive, Hybrid, Agentic RAG) with Self-RAG verification

sources.title: karunaav/RAGchatbot
sources.summary: An agentic document Q&A chatbot — upload a PDF and a LangGraph-orchestrated agent decides when to search it, reflects on its own answers before responding, and remembers past conversation turns. Built with ReAct-style tool calling, hybrid vector + keyword search, episodic/semantic memory, an MCP server, and an evaluation harness, powered by Gemini

sources.title: hq0709/synapse
sources.summary: Official implementation of SYNAPSE: episodic-semantic memory for LLM agents via spreading activation (Findings of ACL 2026), evaluated on LoCoMo

sources.title: Rehan018/Agent-Memory-Architecture-Research-Report
sources.summary: Research project evaluating memory architectures for long-running LLM agents. Compares short-term, episodic, semantic (vector-based), and reflection memory using controlled simulations, analyzing accuracy, cost, latency, and failure modes
